subject: Post-demo hosted trial onramp — sandbox proposal and rate profile
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@finmerchant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo hosted trial onramp — sandbox proposal and rate profile

Hi Alex — thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap from our side and a concrete sandbox proposal so your team can kick the tires on Hosted API:  

Summary from demo (high level)
- Hosted API matches the integration pattern you sketched (REST + streaming).
- We highlighted prefix / KV caching, streaming for chat, and routing fallbacks if capacity spikes.

Why Hosted first?
- Fastest time to value for product teams that want to validate UX + cost per token.
- Can migrate to Dedicated or Private VPC later with the same API and rollout controls.

Sandbox proposal (what we can enable immediately)
- Sandbox endpoints (staging.redwood.net) with API key-scoped access.
- Baseline rate slice: 25 requests/sec (RPS) sustained, 60k tokens/min token ceiling.
- Burst: allow 3x short bursts (up to 75 RPS for <30s) for demo/traffic spikes.
- Concurrency: up to 40 concurrent streaming sessions on the slice; we can increase if you expect more.
- Caching: prefix cache pre-warm + KV cache enabled for repeat prompt patterns (we’ll show how to instrument).
- Security: TLS, VPC peering options later; we’ll log audit events you need for SOC-type evidence.

Mutual action plan (proposed, 3-step trial)
1) Kickoff call + sandbox key provisioning (we do this) — target: next Mon/Tue.
2) 2-week trial: map 3 endpoints (chat, summarization, embeddings) -> exercise traffic patterns and share perf/cost report.
3) Decision checkpoint: keep Hosted, or move to Dedicated sizing estimate / Private onboarding.

Open asks from our side
- Can you confirm expected peak concurrent users and average prompt length (tokens)? You mentioned 1–2k active MAUs; specifics help us size slices.
- Any immediate compliance must-haves (data residency, longer retention windows) for the pilot?

Attachments: redwood_hosted_quickstart_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook + checklist), demo-recording-20280503.mp4

If that plan looks good I’ll provision a sandbox key and book a 30‑minute kickoff with your engineers.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0123

From: Alex Kim <alex@finmerchant.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Li <procure@finmerchant.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo hosted trial onramp — sandbox proposal and rate profile

Priyom — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifying points from our side before we lock in the kickoff:  

1) Traffic profile: peak concurrency for our checkout flow is ~90 concurrent sessions (spiky), but average will be ~25. Prompts vary — median ~120 tokens, occasional long requests up to 1,200 tokens (summaries).
2) Data residency: production needs US-only data residency. For sandbox we’re fine with standard hosted (US), but we need confirmation that production can be scoped to a specific region.
3) SLA & retention: For evaluation we don’t need formal SLA, but procurement will want a simple SOW for the trial (duration + liability). I’ve looped Dana on that.
4) Billing/pricing: we need a rough cost estimate for the 2-week trial; placeholder is fine.

Also — if we land on Hosted for prod we likely want VPC/private connectivity within 3–6 months. Will that path require rework of our integration?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product, FinMerchant
alex@finmerchant.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@finmerchant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo hosted trial onramp — sandbox proposal and rate profile

Thanks Alex — answers inline and next steps below.  

On traffic: 90 peak concurrency is higher than the baseline slice I proposed. We can map you to a larger sandbox slice: 80 RPS sustained, 200 concurrent streaming sessions, and same burst profile (3x short bursts). That will comfortably cover occasional 1,200-token requests; we’ll also add a longer request quota to avoid head-of-line for summary jobs.

Data residency: production can be scoped to US-only regions; for the sandbox we’ll provision in the same region to match topology. Production VPC peering or private deployment is supported — migration path is designed to be API-compatible. You’ll keep the same endpoints logically; we’ll update routing and credentials during the migration.

SOW for trial: we’ll draft a lightweight SOW (2 pages) that covers trial duration, responsibilities, and a simple liability cap. Ben — can you prepare the trial SOW template (two-pager) and share back?

Cost estimate: rough back-of-envelope for the 2-week trial on the larger slice is ~$1,800 — includes burst buffer and monitoring. We’ll produce a line-item estimate in the SOW.

Proposed kickoff windows: Mon May 6 11:00–11:30 PT or Tue May 7 09:30–10:00 PT. Which works for you?

Next steps we’ll take once you confirm kickoff date:
- Provision sandbox keys + endpoint URLs
- Share test prompts and sample instrumentation dashboard
- Enable prefix/KV cache and pre-warm for 48 hrs once test data is available
- Weekly check-in during trial (15 min) and a perf/cost readout at day 14

> On Fri, May 3, 2028 at 6:03 PM Alex Kim <alex@finmerchant.com> wrote:
> > Priyom — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifying points from our side before we lock in the kickoff:  
> > ...

Attachments: redwood_hosted_quickstart_playbook_v1.pdf (updated with the larger-slice table)

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Kim <alex@finmerchant.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Li <procure@finmerchant.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo hosted trial onramp — sandbox proposal and rate profile

That sounds good — thanks. We’ll take the larger sandbox slice and can start the kickoff on Mon May 6 at 11:00 PT. Dana (cc) will handle the SOW/procurement side; Dana, can you confirm any minimal PO or paperwork needed for a two-week eval?

I’ll share a small sample of representative prompts (and a short list of endpoints we want to test) before EOD Sunday. Please include Ben on the SOW so we can keep legal happy.

— Alex
